nodes.label: OpenSpec Apply Change Flow
nodes.author: openspec
nodes.rationale: Enables a developer to implement pending tasks from a change spec sequentially in a loop, pausing on errors or blockers.

nodes.label: OpenSpec Archive Change Flow
nodes.author: openspec
nodes.rationale: Moves completed change directories to an archive folder, ensuring the project's decision history is preserved and versioned.

nodes.label: OpenSpec Artifact Sequence
nodes.author: openspec
nodes.rationale: Guides the generation of spec artifacts in order (e.g. proposal, specs, design, tasks) depending on the active workflow schema.

nodes.label: OpenSpec Explore Stance
nodes.author: openspec
nodes.rationale: A non-prescriptive, curious posture for thinking and mapping architecture, explicitly prohibiting codebase implementation.

nodes.label: OpenSpec Fast-Forward Action
nodes.author: openspec
nodes.rationale: Automatically loops and creates all required artifacts sequentially in one go to prep a change for immediate implementation.

nodes.label: OpenSpec Onboarding Tutorial
nodes.author: openspec
nodes.rationale: Step-by-step guidance utilizing a real codebase task to narrate the full cycle from proposal to archive.

nodes.label: OpenSpec Verification Report
nodes.author: openspec
nodes.rationale: Verifies correctness, completeness, and coherence of code implementations against change specifications before archiving.

nodes.label: GitHub as Backend Database
nodes.rationale: Uses Fine-grained Personal Access Tokens (PAT) to read/write JSON files in a private GitHub repository for offline-first cross-device sync.

nodes.label: Metronome Requirements Specification
nodes.rationale: Specifies support for customizable BPM, denominator, numerator, individual beat profiles (strong, middle, weak), and visual indicators.

nodes.label: JB Guitar Domain Data Models
nodes.rationale: Defines Exercise, PracticePlan, ExerciseSessionState, and Session TypeScript structures for persistent LocalStorage representation.

nodes.label: UI Sketch Layout Prototype
nodes.rationale: Interactive HTML-based wireframes depicting standard viewport frames, dual panel session navigation, metronome settings, and create screens.
